terra.problem: “Cornelius Sends for Peter” takes place in Caesarea, not Joppa. Acts 10:1-8 ends with the men being sent to Joppa, not arriving there.
Jonah 1:1-3 says Jonah fled instead of going to Nineveh, but it does not state that he did not want to obey. Describe what he did rather than his unstated motive.
